# SEC-001: Tool schemas do not depend on a network $ref

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#ref-resolution](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#ref-resolution) |

Scans every tool's inputSchema and outputSchema for a $ref that points outside the schema (an http(s) or other absolute URI). Implementations MUST NOT automatically dereference $ref values that resolve to a network URI, and schemas that fail to validate because of an unresolved external $ref SHOULD be rejected, so a client cannot validate arguments or results for such a tool. MCPProbe cannot observe whether the server itself fetches remote $refs (no MCP message sends the server a schema to validate), so this check covers the half that is visible: the server's own published schemas. Inline the referenced definitions under $defs instead. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain SEC-001`. To leave it out of a run, add `"SEC-001"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
